export default function PrivacyPolicy() { return (

Privacy Policy - The Zuro

Last Updated: {new Date().toLocaleDateString()}

At The Zuro, we value your trust and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data when you use our website.

1. Information We Collect

  • Name, email address, phone number
  • Shipping and billing address
  • Payment details (secured via third-party gateways)
  • Browsing behavior and preferences

2. How We Use Your Information

  • To process orders and payments
  • To improve user experience
  • To send order updates and offers
  • To prevent fraud and ensure security

3. Cookies

We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience and analyze website traffic. You can disable cookies in your browser settings.

4. Sharing Your Data

We do not sell your personal data. We may share it with trusted partners like payment gateways, delivery services, and analytics providers.

5. Data Security

We implement strong security measures to protect your data. However, no online transmission is 100% secure.

6. Your Rights

  • Access your data
  • Update or delete your data
  • Opt-out of marketing emails

7. Contact Us

If you have any questions, contact us at:
Email: support@thezuro.com

); }
